The Head Baker at Silversea Cruises is a senior culinary leadership role responsible for overseeing onboard bakery operations and delivering exceptional, luxury-level baked goods. This position focuses on creating high-quality artisan breads, viennoiserie, and specialty dietary products while ensuring consistency, innovation, and strict adherence to international standards and company procedures. Working with a top-tier culinary team, the Head Baker plays a key role in enhancing the guest dining experience across premium venues, maintaining excellence in production, and contributing to the brand’s commitment to outstanding, memorable dining at sea.
Reporting to Pastry Chef and Executive Chef
q: Proven experience as Head Baker or Senior Baker in a luxury hotel, Michelin-starred restaurant, or cruise line.
Advanced knowledge of artisanal bread baking, laminated doughs, and modern dietary alternatives.
Culinary degree or equivalent certification preferred.
Cruise ship or international hospitality experience is highly advantageous.
Appropriate certification as required by regulations.
In-depth understanding of USPH, ILO, ISO, HACCP, and maritime safety procedures.
Superior ability to deliver an excellent and consistent culinary experience while maintaining sound cost control.
Strong leadership and organizational skills in a high-volume, fine-dining production environment.
Willing to travel extensively and be willing to spend extended periods at sea.
Fluent English (verbal and written) is mandatory.
Additional languages (French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Mandarin) are considered a plus.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft applications, Fidelio and MXP.
r: Lead Production: Oversee and actively participate in daily preparation of breads, pastries, and bakery items across all onboard dining venues, including special events.
Artisanal Baking: Create high-quality baked goods such as sourdough, laminated pastries, gluten-free items, and regionally inspired specialties aligned with luxury standards.
Collaboration: Follow company standards and recipes while working with the Executive Chef, Pastry Chef, and Fleet Corporate Pastry Chef to develop and adapt bakery offerings.
Quality Assurance: Maintain exceptional consistency, presentation, and attention to detail in all bakery products.
Sanitation & Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to USPH, HACCP, and company hygiene and safety standards, keeping operations clean and efficient.
Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels, manage requisitions, control portions, and reduce waste through effective production planning.
Team Leadership: Train, supervise, and mentor bakery staff, promoting high standards and professional growth.
Guest Interaction: Engage with guests during culinary events and demonstrations, enhancing their onboard experience.

d: Join our Client Management team and help deliver the exceptional client experience that sits at the heart of Corporate & Investment Banking.

As a Client Manager Graduate, you'll work closely with Relationship Managers, Product Partners and specialist teams to support some of the region's leading corporates and financial institutions. You'll gain exposure to client relationship management, account servicing, onboarding, credit processes and risk management, helping clients navigate their banking needs while building the foundations of a successful banking career.

Throughout the programme, you'll develop a broad understanding of how Corporate & Investment Banking serves clients across cash management, trade finance, lending and financial markets, while working alongside experienced professionals in a dynamic, international environment.
This is an opportunity to build commercial, analytical and relationship management skills while gaining first-hand exposure to how a global bank supports clients across the UAE and beyond.
q: We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.
We're looking for people who can
Build relationships and communicate confidently with a wide range of stakeholders.
Take ownership and show initiative when tackling challenges.
Think critically and solve problems using sound judgement.
Learn quickly, stay curious and continuously develop.
Collaborate effectively across teams and functions.
Stay organised and attentive to detail in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in clients, banking and global markets.
We are a super-connector for many of the world's largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth.

We work with governments, financial institutions and some of the world's most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.

What makes us distinctive is our combination of deep local expertise with an extensive and unique global network. We support clients across risk management, financing, transaction services, advisory and sustainable finance, helping move capital to where it's needed most and supporting the real economy across our footprint.
To be eligible for this graduate programme, you need to be in your final year of study or be a recent graduate.
